sentences.text: The genus Songlingornis was formally described by Hou in 1997.
Songlingornis belongs to the parent group Hongshanornithidae.
Fossils of this animal have been found in the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning, China.
The age of these rocks is disputed, though they are likely around 125 to 120 million years old.
More precise estimates place the time range for Songlingornis between 121.4 and 113.2 million years ago.
